cards.t: Blur to Shut Down Website on November 12
cards.b: The NFT marketplace Blur is shutting down its website on November 12 after trading volumes collapsed by 99% from its peak. Upbit also suspended Blur deposits after flagging the token for review.

per.BLUR: Website shutdown and deposit suspension create severe headwinds for the token.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Details on token migration or ultimate fate of user funds beyond the website closure.

cards.t: Binance Lists RWUSD with Zero Fee Promotion
cards.b: Binance announced it will list RWUSD and launch a zero trading fee promotion for the token.

per.RWUSD: Binance listing and zero fee promotion will increase accessibility and trading volume.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST

cards.t: Sberbank Secures Approval for December Crypto Trading Launch in Russia
cards.b: Russia's largest bank, Sberbank, secured regulatory approval and set a date of December 1 to open crypto trading for all clients, having already tested BTC, ETH, and USDT trades in its app.

per.BTC: Opening to all clients on Russia's largest bank expands regulated access.
per.ETH: Opening to all clients on Russia's largest bank expands regulated access.
per.USDT: Opening to all clients on Russia's largest bank expands regulated access.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Specific trading pairs and technical integration steps.

cards.t: Strive Raises $500M via New Preferred Share Class to Buy Bitcoin
cards.b: Strive is raising $500 million to purchase additional Bitcoin by introducing a new preferred share class offering a fixed 15% dividend yield at par.

per.BTC: Capital raise specifically targeted at acquiring more Bitcoin for the corporate treasury.

cards.label: MODERATE CATALYST
cards.missing: The timeline for completing the capital raise and subsequent Bitcoin purchases.
